title: Choose Settings and Documents
question: Each option makes Settings the single home for live connections and gives every student a Documents destination with version history. Choose the structure that should carry both pages.

options.label: Record & Revision Desk
options.lineage: Refero connected-account registers and document backup histories
options.thesis: Settings is a quiet control plane; Documents is a master-detail desk where one record and its versions stay in view together.
options.viewport: Settings uses a compact local section rail and full-width Canvas and timetable rows. Documents uses a broad registry on the left and a selected-document pane on the right with its version rail, progression figures, replace and remove actions.
options.risk: The two-pane document view needs a deliberate single-column drill-in pattern on phones.

options.label: Academic Archive Runway
options.lineage: departure boards, academic ledgers, and visual version timelines
options.thesis: The document history itself becomes the organising axis, so transcript progression reads as a journey through the degree.
options.viewport: Settings remains a single connection register. Documents opens with a compact degree-progress runway, then groups Transcript, Academic Work and Academic Calendar into ruled rows whose versions are stops on one dated line.
options.risk: A strong overview can become too abstract if individual file actions are not kept immediately reachable.

options.label: Source Control Desk
options.lineage: Refero integration boards and source provenance tools
options.thesis: Connections and uploads share one source vocabulary while remaining separate destinations: live feeds in Settings, owned records in Documents.
options.viewport: Settings begins with a two-source status band and expands each connection inline. Documents is a dense source table with type, current version, last change and record impact; selecting a row opens an edge-aligned revision ledger below it.
options.risk: This is the densest option and could feel administrative unless the upload and replace paths remain warm and direct.
